- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `feat/1096-size-diet` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 9
- **Additions**: +191
- **Deletions**: -36
- **Created**: 2026-10-04T13:54:04Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-04T16:47:24Z

## PR Description

Part of #1096 — slice 2: the cuts slice 1 explicitly deferred (AC4 + direction-3 analog on macOS, owner-decision items untouched). Budget-gate script unchanged; baselines reseeded onto the measured post-cut shape.

## Delivered

### AC4 — macOS app ships without `wasm_run_flutter.framework` (27.1 MB unpacked)
`vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/wasm_run_flutter.podspec`: `s.vendored_frameworks` removed. The embedded dynamic framework was a **never-loaded fallback**: the Dart FFI surface resolves via dlsym on the app's own executable — `Runner.xcodeproj` force_loads `WasmRun.xcframework/macos-arm64_x86_64/libwasm_run_dart.a` and exports the `_wire_*` symbols (verified per build by the existing `wasm_run FFI symbol verification` step). `createLibraryImpl` (`vendor/wasm_run/lib/src/ffi/io.dart:50-56`) tries `DynamicLibrary.executable()` first on macOS and `_validateLibrary` checks exactly `wire_compile_wasm` — the symbol the CI gate asserts. So `WasmRunLibrary.setUp(override: false)` no-ops on the pruned build; **no Dart change, no boot-time dylib download**. The XCFramework cache/restore/download stays untouched — the static archive feeds the force_load and the Podfile symbol check (`Podfile:132-141`); `wasmrun_restore_budget_test` stays green (5/5).

### macOS flutter_assets diet (direction 3 analog, ~52 MB unpacked)
`build-macos.yml` Package step prunes, **before any codesign**:
- `flutter_assets/assets/wasm` — ~47 MB of WASI interpreter modules loaded exclusively through `WasiSandboxShell` (`env_factory_io.dart` routes desktops to the host `Process` shell; every `rootBundle.load('assets/wasm/…')` lives in the mobile-only shell — re-verified on current main). Mobile (iOS/Android) builds untouched — they keep the full set (backward-compat invariant).
- `flutter_assets/packages/js_widget_runtime/test` — 5.6 MB coach_anny.glb test fixture of the pub package, declared as package assets; nothing in the app references that path (grep over flutter_app/lib, packages, lib, bundled JS apps).

### Same fixture prune on every other shipped web shape (5.6 MB each)
`scripts/build_browser_ext.sh` (extension zip), `.github/workflows/pages.yml` (fa1.dev), `scripts/build_office_addin.sh` (outlook pane).

### AC1 ratchet — baselines reseeded onto the post-cut shape
Both `scripts/size_budget` floors rewritten from the **real v1.0.504 release artifacts** with the cuts applied (`--reseed`; script unchanged):
- mac zip: TOTAL 203,341,721 → 111,001,004 B unpacked (**−45.3%**); compressed auto-update zip 75.8 MB → 41.0 MB (**−46%**). DMG shrinks identically.
- extension: TOTAL 78,149,373 → 72,527,489 B (**−7.1%**); compressed 28.3 → 26.4 MB.

Gate proofs (all against the committed floors):
- cut mac zip vs pre-PR baseline: PASS (TOTAL −45.3%, no line grew) — the cut ships green even before the reseed lands
- pre-cut v1.0.504 mac zip vs new floor: **FAIL** — 4 NEW >5% lines (`wasm_run_flutter.framework` 27.1 MB, `python.wasm` 30.4 MB, `coreutils.wasm` 8.4 MB, `coach_anny.glb` 5.6 MB), TOTAL +83.2%
- pre-cut extension vs new floor: **FAIL** — glb NEW >5%, TOTAL +7.8%
- tampered cut zip (main binary +10%): **FAIL** (GREW)
- `size_manifest.py selftest`: 11/11 PASS
- per-line shapes of both cut zips otherwise byte-identical to the shipped releases (only the cut lines + engine-bump drift between v1.0.493 baselines and v1.0.504)

### Not needed (verified, deliberately no diff)
- No `wasm_setup_io.dart` change: with the framework gone, `setUp(override:false)` → `isReachable()` → `executable()` succeeds (static link + exported symbols, CI-gated) → early return. The download path never runs on release or dev builds (force_load applies to both).
- iOS podspec untouched — iOS vendors its own framework slice and statically links it.

## Remaining (owner decisions / later slices, unchanged from the issue)
- AC5: iOS lite flavor vs accept-35 MB (LiteRT/Gemma on-device stack, 35 MB iOS / 45 MB macOS)
- OQ3: `--wasm` (skwasm) spike; App.framework 89–92 MB code-size audit (direction 6)
- mac canvaskit rev-dir inner mirror (web-only shape; needs network trace before cutting — extension/web floors already carry it)
- Known gate floor: NEW-line share is 5% of TOTAL — a future single line under that (e.g. a small asset) regrows silently; the TOTAL line still covers aggregate drift.

## CI note
Per fleet policy this PR does not dispatch or rerun workflows; SM schedules CI.

          for SYM in _wire_compile_wasm _store_dart_post_cobject _init_frb_dart_api_dl; do

      - name: Package as DMG
        id: package
        env:
          SIGNED: ${{ steps.signing.outputs.signed }}
          PROFILE_EMBEDDED: ${{ steps.signing.outputs.profile_embedded }}
          MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID: ${{ secrets.MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID }}
          VERSION: ${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          ARCH="${{ matrix.arch }}"
          APP_PATH="flutter_app/build/macos/Build/Products/Release/Fa.app"
          DMG_NAME="fa-macos-${ARCH}-${VERSION}.dmg"

          # Size diet (#1096 AC4 + direction 3): drop what no macOS code path
          # can load — before any codesign so the seal covers the shipped
          # tree. Both cuts ride in flutter_assets inside App.framework:
          # 1) assets/wasm (~47 MB) — WASI interpreter modules loaded
          #    exclusively via WasiSandboxShell (env_factory_io.dart routes
          #    desktops to the host Process shell; every rootBundle.load of
          #    assets/wasm lives in the mobile-only shell).
          # 2) packages/js_widget_runtime/test — the pub package's
          #    own test fixture (coach_anny.glb, 5.6 MB); nothing in the app
          #    references that path (the live model, when used, is fetched
          #    by the JS-app catalog, not bundled).
          ASSETS="$APP_PATH/Contents/Frameworks/App.framework/Versions/A/Resources/flutter_assets"
          # Re-enable path (review, #1096): if a desktop WASI/sandbox mode
          # ever ships (WasiSandboxShell on macOS), revert this rm and
          # reseed assets/wasm — until then a desktop wasm load would fail
          # as a missing asset, not a #1224-class "no lazy loader" stub.
          rm -rf "$ASSETS/assets/wasm" "$ASSETS/packages/js_widget_runtime/test"

          rm -f fa-macos-*.dmg tmp-fa.dmg
          rm -rf dmg-staging

          echo "Packaging: $APP_PATH → $DMG_NAME (arch: $ARCH)"

          if [ "$SIGNED" = "true" ] && [ -n "$MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID" ]; then
            echo "Signing .app bundle..."

            RESVG_BIN="$APP_PATH/Contents/Resources/resvg"
            if [ -f "$RESVG_BIN" ]; then
              echo "Stripping extended attributes from resvg..."
              xattr -cr "$RESVG_BIN" 2>/dev/null || true
              echo "Signing resvg binary..."
              codesign --force --sign "$MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID" \
                --options runtime \
                --timestamp \
                "$RESVG_BIN"
            fi

            find "$APP_PATH" -type f \( -perm +111 -o -name '*.dylib' \) | while read -r bin; do
              if codesign -dv "$bin" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "$MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID"; then
                continue
              fi
              echo "Signing nested binary: $bin"
              codesign --force --sign "$MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID" \
                --options runtime \
                --timestamp \

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1227
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1227
- **Title**: feat(1096): mac size diet — wasm_run_flutter.framework + never-loaded assets, ratcheted
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `feat/1096-size-diet` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 9
- **Additions**: +191
- **Deletions**: -36
- **Created**: 2026-10-04T13:54:04Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-04T16:47:24Z

## PR Description

Part of #1096 — slice 2: the cuts slice 1 explicitly deferred (AC4 + direction-3 analog on macOS, owner-decision items untouched). Budget-gate script unchanged; baselines reseeded onto the measured post-cut shape.

## Delivered

### AC4 — macOS app ships without `wasm_run_flutter.framework` (27.1 MB unpacked)
`vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/wasm_run_flutter.podspec`: `s.vendored_frameworks` removed. The embedded dynamic framework was a **never-loaded fallback**: the Dart FFI surface resolves via dlsym on the app's own executable — `Runner.xcodeproj` force_loads `WasmRun.xcframework/macos-arm64_x86_64/libwasm_run_dart.a` and exports the `_wire_*` symbols (verified per build by the existing `wasm_run FFI symbol verification` step). `createLibraryImpl` (`vendor/wasm_run/lib/src/ffi/io.dart:50-56`) tries `DynamicLibrary.executable()` first on macOS and `_validateLibrary` checks exactly `wire_compile_wasm` — the symbol the CI gate asserts. So `WasmRunLibrary.setUp(override: false)` no-ops on the pruned build; **no Dart change, no boot-time dylib download**. The XCFramework cache/restore/download stays untouched — the static archive feeds the force_load and the Podfile symbol check (`Podfile:132-141`); `wasmrun_restore_budget_test` stays green (5/5).

### macOS flutter_assets diet (direction 3 analog, ~52 MB unpacked)
`build-macos.yml` Package step prunes, **before any codesign**:
- `flutter_assets/assets/wasm` — ~47 MB of WASI interpreter modules loaded exclusively through `WasiSandboxShell` (`env_factory_io.dart` routes desktops to the host `Process` shell; every `rootBundle.load('assets/wasm/…')` lives in the mobile-only shell — re-verified on current main). Mobile (iOS/Android) builds untouched — they keep the full set (backward-compat invariant).
- `flutter_assets/packages/js_widget_runtime/test` — 5.6 MB coach_anny.glb test fixture of the pub package, declared as package assets; nothing in the app references that path (grep over flutter_app/lib, packages, lib, bundled JS apps).

### Same fixture prune on every other shipped web shape (5.6 MB each)
`scripts/build_browser_ext.sh` (extension zip), `.github/workflows/pages.yml` (fa1.dev), `scripts/build_office_addin.sh` (outlook pane).

### AC1 ratchet — baselines reseeded onto the post-cut shape
Both `scripts/size_budget` floors rewritten from the **real v1.0.504 release artifacts** with the cuts applied (`--reseed`; script unchanged):
- mac zip: TOTAL 203,341,721 → 111,001,004 B unpacked (**−45.3%**); compressed auto-update zip 75.8 MB → 41.0 MB (**−46%**). DMG shrinks identically.
- extension: TOTAL 78,149,373 → 72,527,489 B (**−7.1%**); compressed 28.3 → 26.4 MB.

Gate proofs (all against the committed floors):
- cut mac zip vs pre-PR baseline: PASS (TOTAL −45.3%, no line grew) — the cut ships green even before the reseed lands
- pre-cut v1.0.504 mac zip vs new floor: **FAIL** — 4 NEW >5% lines (`wasm_run_flutter.framework` 27.1 MB, `python.wasm` 30.4 MB, `coreutils.wasm` 8.4 MB, `coach_anny.glb` 5.6 MB), TOTAL +83.2%
- pre-cut extension vs new floor: **FAIL** — glb NEW >5%, TOTAL +7.8%
- tampered cut zip (main binary +10%): **FAIL** (GREW)
- `size_manifest.py selftest`: 11/11 PASS
- per-line shapes of both cut zips otherwise byte-identical to the shipped releases (only the cut lines + engine-bump drift between v1.0.493 baselines and v1.0.504)

### Not needed (verified, deliberately no diff)
- No `wasm_setup_io.dart` change: with the framework gone, `setUp(override:false)` → `isReachable()` → `executable()` succeeds (static link + exported symbols, CI-gated) → early return. The download path never runs on release or dev builds (force_load applies to both).
- iOS podspec untouched — iOS vendors its own framework slice and statically links it.

## Remaining (owner decisions / later slices, unchanged from the issue)
- AC5: iOS lite flavor vs accept-35 MB (LiteRT/Gemma on-device stack, 35 MB iOS / 45 MB macOS)
- OQ3: `--wasm` (skwasm) spike; App.framework 89–92 MB code-size audit (direction 6)
- mac canvaskit rev-dir inner mirror (web-only shape; needs network trace before cutting — extension/web floors already carry it)
- Known gate floor: NEW-line share is 5% of TOTAL — a future single line under that (e.g. a small asset) regrows silently; the TOTAL line still covers aggregate drift.

## CI note
Per fleet policy this PR does not dispatch or rerun workflows; SM schedules CI.

+//   arm64: "_drop_dart_object", … referenced from:

+// target force_loads WasmRun.xcframework's libwasm_run_dart.a and exports
+// every C-ABI symbol (flutter_app/macos/Podfile), and package:wasm_run
+// resolves them at runtime via DynamicLibrary.executable(). EnforceBundling
+// is the iOS mechanism (the app there statically links the pod's vendored
+// framework and the dummy keeps dead-code stripping from discarding the
+// wire_* roots); it must not ride in the macOS pod once the framework is

WIRE_COUNT=$(echo "$EXPORTS" | grep -c " _wire_" || true)
          echo "wasm_run wire_* exports in binary: $WIRE_COUNT"
          for SYM in _wire_compile_wasm _store_dart_post_cobject _init_frb_dart_api_dl; do
            if ! echo "$EXPORTS" | grep -qE " ${SYM}\$"; then
              echo "::error::$SYM is not exported from the app binary — wasm_run would crash at runtime (white screen)"
              exit 1
            fi
          done
          echo "✅ wasm_run FFI symbols are exported"

      - name: Package as DMG
        id: package
        env:
          SIGNED: ${{ steps.signing.outputs.signed }}
          PROFILE_EMBEDDED: ${{ steps.signing.outputs.profile_embedded }}
          MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID: ${{ secrets.MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID }}
          VERSION: ${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          ARCH="${{ matrix.arch }}"
          APP_PATH="flutter_app/build/macos/Build/Products/Release/Fa.app"
          DMG_NAME="fa-macos-${ARCH}-${VERSION}.dmg"

          # Size diet (#1096 AC4 + direction 3): drop what no macOS code path
          # can load — before any codesign so the seal covers the shipped
          # tree. Both cuts ride in flutter_assets inside App.framework:
          # 1) assets/wasm (~47 MB) — WASI interpreter modules loaded
          #    exclusively via WasiSandboxShell (env_factory_io.dart routes
          #    desktops to the host Process shell; every rootBundle.load of
          #    assets/wasm lives in the mobile-only shell).
          # 2) packages/js_widget_runtime/test — the pub package's
          #    own test fixture (coach_anny.glb, 5.6 MB); nothing in the app
          #    references that path (the live model, when used, is fetched
          #    by the JS-app catalog, not bundled).
          ASSETS="$APP_PATH/Contents/Frameworks/App.framework/Versions/A/Resources/flutter_assets"
          # Re-enable path (review, #1096): if a desktop WASI/sandbox mode
          # ever ships (WasiSandboxShell on macOS), revert this rm and
          # reseed assets/wasm — until then a desktop wasm load would fail
          # as a missing asset, not a #1224-class "no lazy loader" stub.
          rm -rf "$ASSETS/assets/wasm" "$ASSETS/packages/js_widget_runtime/test"

          rm -f fa-macos-*.dmg tmp-fa.dmg
          rm -rf dmg-staging

          echo "Packaging: $APP_PATH → $DMG_NAME (arch: $ARCH)"

          if [ "$SIGNED" = "true" ] && [ -n "$MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID" ]; then
            echo "Signing .app bundle..."

            RESVG_BIN="$APP_PATH/Contents/Resources/resvg"
            if [ -f "$RESVG_BIN" ]; then
              echo "Stripping extended attributes from resvg..."
              xattr -cr "$RESVG_BIN" 2>/dev/null || true
              echo "Signing resvg binary..."
              codesign --force --sign "$MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID" \
                --options runtime \
                --timestamp \
                "$RESVG_BIN"
            fi

            find "$APP_PATH" -type f \( -perm +111 -o -name '*.dylib' \) | while read -r bin; do
              if codesign -dv "$bin" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "$MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID"; then
                continue
              fi
              echo "Signing nested binary: $bin"
              codesign --force --sign "$MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID" \
                --options runtime \
                --timestamp \
                "$bin" 2>/dev/null || true
            done

            if [ "$PROFILE_EMBEDDED" = "true" ] && [ -f "profile.provisionprofile" ]; then
              echo "Embedding provisioning profile..."
              cp profile.provisionprofile "$APP_PATH/Contents/embedded.provisionprofile"
              APP_ID=$(security cms -D -i profile.provisionprofile | plutil -extract Entitlements xml1 -o - - | grep -A 1 'com.apple.application-identifier' | tail -1 | sed 's/.*<string>\(.*\)<\/string>.*/\1/')
              TEAM_ID="${APP_ID%%.*}"
              # Start from Release.entitlements (network client+server, file
              # bookmarks, calendar, contacts, health, homekit, audio input)
              # and inject the provisioning identity keys — do NOT collapse
              # to a sandbox-only dict: the app needs every entitlement the
              # sandbox declares, and dropping them breaks SSO callback
              # servers, file access, and OS-level permission flows in the
              # signed production build.
              cp flutter_app/macos/Runner/Release.entitlements entitlements.plist
              # PlistBuddy handles dotted top-level key names (plutil
              # -insert/-replace treats dots as nested key separators).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1227
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1227
- **Title**: feat(1096): mac size diet — wasm_run_flutter.framework + never-loaded assets, ratcheted
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `feat/1096-size-diet` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 9
- **Additions**: +191
- **Deletions**: -36
- **Created**: 2026-10-04T13:54:04Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-04T16:47:24Z

## PR Description

Part of #1096 — slice 2: the cuts slice 1 explicitly deferred (AC4 + direction-3 analog on macOS, owner-decision items untouched). Budget-gate script unchanged; baselines reseeded onto the measured post-cut shape.

## Delivered

### AC4 — macOS app ships without `wasm_run_flutter.framework` (27.1 MB unpacked)
`vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/wasm_run_flutter.podspec`: `s.vendored_frameworks` removed. The embedded dynamic framework was a **never-loaded fallback**: the Dart FFI surface resolves via dlsym on the app's own executable — `Runner.xcodeproj` force_loads `WasmRun.xcframework/macos-arm64_x86_64/libwasm_run_dart.a` and exports the `_wire_*` symbols (verified per build by the existing `wasm_run FFI symbol verification` step). `createLibraryImpl` (`vendor/wasm_run/lib/src/ffi/io.dart:50-56`) tries `DynamicLibrary.executable()` first on macOS and `_validateLibrary` checks exactly `wire_compile_wasm` — the symbol the CI gate asserts. So `WasmRunLibrary.setUp(override: false)` no-ops on the pruned build; **no Dart change, no boot-time dylib download**. The XCFramework cache/restore/download stays untouched — the static archive feeds the force_load and the Podfile symbol check (`Podfile:132-141`); `wasmrun_restore_budget_test` stays green (5/5).

### macOS flutter_assets diet (direction 3 analog, ~52 MB unpacked)
`build-macos.yml` Package step prunes, **before any codesign**:
- `flutter_assets/assets/wasm` — ~47 MB of WASI interpreter modules loaded exclusively through `WasiSandboxShell` (`env_factory_io.dart` routes desktops to the host `Process` shell; every `rootBundle.load('assets/wasm/…')` lives in the mobile-only shell — re-verified on current main). Mobile (iOS/Android) builds untouched — they keep the full set (backward-compat invariant).
- `flutter_assets/packages/js_widget_runtime/test` — 5.6 MB coach_anny.glb test fixture of the pub package, declared as package assets; nothing in the app references that path (grep over flutter_app/lib, packages, lib, bundled JS apps).

### Same fixture prune on every other shipped web shape (5.6 MB each)
`scripts/build_browser_ext.sh` (extension zip), `.github/workflows/pages.yml` (fa1.dev), `scripts/build_office_addin.sh` (outlook pane).

### AC1 ratchet — baselines reseeded onto the post-cut shape
Both `scripts/size_budget` floors rewritten from the **real v1.0.504 release artifacts** with the cuts applied (`--reseed`; script unchanged):
- mac zip: TOTAL 203,341,721 → 111,001,004 B unpacked (**−45.3%**); compressed auto-update zip 75.8 MB → 41.0 MB (**−46%**). DMG shrinks identically.
- extension: TOTAL 78,149,373 → 72,527,489 B (**−7.1%**); compressed 28.3 → 26.4 MB.

Gate proofs (all against the committed floors):
- cut mac zip vs pre-PR baseline: PASS (TOTAL −45.3%, no line grew) — the cut ships green even before the reseed lands
- pre-cut v1.0.504 mac zip vs new floor: **FAIL** — 4 NEW >5% lines (`wasm_run_flutter.framework` 27.1 MB, `python.wasm` 30.4 MB, `coreutils.wasm` 8.4 MB, `coach_anny.glb` 5.6 MB), TOTAL +83.2%
- pre-cut extension vs new floor: **FAIL** — glb NEW >5%, TOTAL +7.8%
- tampered cut zip (main binary +10%): **FAIL** (GREW)
- `size_manifest.py selftest`: 11/11 PASS
- per-line shapes of both cut zips otherwise byte-identical to the shipped releases (only the cut lines + engine-bump drift between v1.0.493 baselines and v1.0.504)

### Not needed (verified, deliberately no diff)
- No `wasm_setup_io.dart` change: with the framework gone, `setUp(override:false)` → `isReachable()` → `executable()` succeeds (static link + exported symbols, CI-gated) → early return. The download path never runs on release or dev builds (force_load applies to both).
- iOS podspec untouched — iOS vendors its own framework slice and statically links it.

## Remaining (owner decisions / later slices, unchanged from the issue)
- AC5: iOS lite flavor vs accept-35 MB (LiteRT/Gemma on-device stack, 35 MB iOS / 45 MB macOS)
- OQ3: `--wasm` (skwasm) spike; App.framework 89–92 MB code-size audit (direction 6)
- mac canvaskit rev-dir inner mirror (web-only shape; needs network trace before cutting — extension/web floors already carry it)
- Known gate floor: NEW-line share is 5% of TOTAL — a future single line under that (e.g. a small asset) regrows silently; the TOTAL line still covers aggregate drift.

## CI note
Per fleet policy this PR does not dispatch or rerun workflows; SM schedules CI.

# Rework: fix red `Build macOS (debug)` leg (Quality gate)

## Issues/Notes

- **CI failure (root cause)**: head `cc81c735` went red on `build-macos` (Quality gate leg `Build macOS (debug)`). The link step of the `wasm_run_flutter` pod target failed with **~200 undefined symbols for architecture arm64** (`_drop_dart_object`, `_inflate_*`, `_new_*`, `_wire_*`, …) referenced from `_dummy_method_to_enforce_bundling in EnforceBundling.o`.
- **Why**: the PR removed `s.vendored_frameworks` from `vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/wasm_run_flutter.podspec` (AC4 — drop the 27 MB never-loaded `wasm_run_flutter.framework`). But `Classes/EnforceBundling.swift` still rode in the macOS pod. Its dummy references the flutter_rust_bridge symbols that **only the removed vendored dynamic framework used to satisfy** at the pod-target link step — so the pod target now links against nothing defining them and the build fails before the app ever links.
- **Why no other fix**: re-vendoring anything (`vendored_frameworks` or `vendored_libraries` on the static archive) would either resurrect the 27 MB framework or statically link the rust archive into the pod framework — recreating the bloat AC4 removed. The pod target also never needed the dummy: the **Runner** target force_loads `libwasm_run_dart.a` and exports every FFI symbol (`flutter_app/macos/Podfile`, non-Debug; Debug exports all globals), and `package:wasm_run` resolves them via `DynamicLibrary.executable()`. `EnforceBundling` is the **iOS** mechanism (app statically links the pod's vendored framework there; the dummy keeps dead-code stripping from discarding the `wire_*` roots) — iOS podspec is untouched.
- **Review threads**: thread 1 (re-enable pointer note) was already resolved before this rework (pointer landed at the rm site in `build-macos.yml`). The only open item is the CI-red notice — fixed by this change.

## Approach

TDD (RED → GREEN → full suite), same static-lint style as the existing `wasmrun_restore_budget_test.dart` (the failure is link-time on macOS; this Linux runner cannot run `flutter build macos`, so the guard lints the exact invariant the linker enforces):

1. **RED** — added `test/wasmrun_macos_pod_link_test.dart`: fails if the macOS podspec vendors any framework/library, if `macos/Classes/` compiles any source (`.swift`/`.m`/`.c`/…) while doing so, or if the Podfile stops force_loading/exporting the static archive (the provider side). It reproduced the failure: `EnforceBundling.swift` flagged as the offending compiled source.
2. **GREEN** — removed `vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/Classes/EnforceBundling.swift` (header-only pod; `frb.h` stays as the public FFI surface so `pod install` materializes the target) and rewrote the podspec comment to document *why*: the header-only macOS pod, where the symbols actually come from (Runner force_load + exported symbols), the iOS-vs-macOS EnforceBundling distinction, and the exact link error this prevents.
3. Verified the podspec still parses (`ruby -c` → Syntax OK) and no remaining reference to `EnforceBundling` exists in the macOS plugin/app.

## Files Modified

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/Classes/EnforceBundling.swift` | **Deleted** — iOS-only mechanism; its undefined FFI references broke the pod-target link once the vendored framework was removed |
| `vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/wasm_run_flutter.podspec` | Comment rewritten: documents the header-only macOS pod, the Runner force_load/export symbol source, and the link failure this guards against |
| `test/wasmrun_macos_pod_link_test.dart` | **New** — static lint pinning the linkability invariant (no vendored framework/library; no compiled sources in the macOS pod; Podfile keeps force_load + exported_symbol) |

## Test Coverage

- `test/wasmrun_macos_pod_link_test.dart` — 3/3 PASS (failed 2/3 before the fix, reproducing the exact CI failure mode; the third leg guards the symbol provider).
- `test/wasmrun_restore_budget_test.dart` — 5/5 PASS (unaffected; the XCFramework download block the restore step depends on stays).
- Full test-core suite (`dart test --exclude-tags llm,browser-ext,perf,pty`, same selection CI runs) — see final comment; `dart analyze` clean on the new test; `dart format` applied.

Per fleet policy this PR does not dispatch or rerun workflows; the push of this fix produces a new head, which SM validation picks up.

So `WasmRunLibrary.setUp(override: false)` no-ops on the pruned build; **no Dart change, no boot-time dylib download**. The XCFramework cache/restore/download stays untouched — the static archive feeds the force_load and the Podfile symbol check (`Podfile:132-141`); `wasmrun_restore_budget_test` stays green (5/5).

### macOS flutter_assets diet (direction 3 analog, ~52 MB unpacked)

Mobile (iOS/Android) builds untouched — they keep the full set (backward-compat invariant).
- `flutter_assets/packages/js_widget_runtime/test` — 5.6 MB coach_anny.glb test fixture of the pub package, declared as package assets; nothing in the app references that path (grep over flutter_app/lib, packages, lib, bundled JS apps).

### Same fixture prune on every other shipped web shape (5.6 MB each)
`scripts/build_browser_ext.sh` (extension zip), `.github/workflows/pages.yml` (fa1.dev), `scripts/build_office_addin.sh` (outlook pane).

Both `scripts/size_budget` floors rewritten from the **real v1.0.504 release artifacts** with the cuts applied (`--reseed`; script unchanged):
- mac zip: TOTAL 203,341,721 → 111,001,004 B unpacked (**−45.3%**); compressed auto-update zip 75.8 MB → 41.0 MB (**−46%**). DMG shrinks identically.
- extension: TOTAL 78,149,373 → 72,527,489 B (**−7.1%**); compressed 28.3 → 26.4 MB.

Gate proofs (all against the committed floors):

- No `wasm_setup_io.dart` change: with the framework gone, `setUp(override:false)` → `isReachable()` → `executable()` succeeds (static link + exported symbols, CI-gated) → early return. The download path never runs on release or dev builds (force_load applies to both).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1227
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1227
- **Title**: feat(1096): mac size diet — wasm_run_flutter.framework + never-loaded assets, ratcheted
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `feat/1096-size-diet` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 9
- **Additions**: +191
- **Deletions**: -36
- **Created**: 2026-10-04T13:54:04Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-04T16:47:24Z

## PR Description

Part of #1096 — slice 2: the cuts slice 1 explicitly deferred (AC4 + direction-3 analog on macOS, owner-decision items untouched). Budget-gate script unchanged; baselines reseeded onto the measured post-cut shape.

## Delivered

### AC4 — macOS app ships without `wasm_run_flutter.framework` (27.1 MB unpacked)
`vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/wasm_run_flutter.podspec`: `s.vendored_frameworks` removed. The embedded dynamic framework was a **never-loaded fallback**: the Dart FFI surface resolves via dlsym on the app's own executable — `Runner.xcodeproj` force_loads `WasmRun.xcframework/macos-arm64_x86_64/libwasm_run_dart.a` and exports the `_wire_*` symbols (verified per build by the existing `wasm_run FFI symbol verification` step). `createLibraryImpl` (`vendor/wasm_run/lib/src/ffi/io.dart:50-56`) tries `DynamicLibrary.executable()` first on macOS and `_validateLibrary` checks exactly `wire_compile_wasm` — the symbol the CI gate asserts. So `WasmRunLibrary.setUp(override: false)` no-ops on the pruned build; **no Dart change, no boot-time dylib download**. The XCFramework cache/restore/download stays untouched — the static archive feeds the force_load and the Podfile symbol check (`Podfile:132-141`); `wasmrun_restore_budget_test` stays green (5/5).

### macOS flutter_assets diet (direction 3 analog, ~52 MB unpacked)
`build-macos.yml` Package step prunes, **before any codesign**:
- `flutter_assets/assets/wasm` — ~47 MB of WASI interpreter modules loaded exclusively through `WasiSandboxShell` (`env_factory_io.dart` routes desktops to the host `Process` shell; every `rootBundle.load('assets/wasm/…')` lives in the mobile-only shell — re-verified on current main). Mobile (iOS/Android) builds untouched — they keep the full set (backward-compat invariant).
- `flutter_assets/packages/js_widget_runtime/test` — 5.6 MB coach_anny.glb test fixture of the pub package, declared as package assets; nothing in the app references that path (grep over flutter_app/lib, packages, lib, bundled JS apps).

### Same fixture prune on every other shipped web shape (5.6 MB each)
`scripts/build_browser_ext.sh` (extension zip), `.github/workflows/pages.yml` (fa1.dev), `scripts/build_office_addin.sh` (outlook pane).

### AC1 ratchet — baselines reseeded onto the post-cut shape
Both `scripts/size_budget` floors rewritten from the **real v1.0.504 release artifacts** with the cuts applied (`--reseed`; script unchanged):
- mac zip: TOTAL 203,341,721 → 111,001,004 B unpacked (**−45.3%**); compressed auto-update zip 75.8 MB → 41.0 MB (**−46%**). DMG shrinks identically.
- extension: TOTAL 78,149,373 → 72,527,489 B (**−7.1%**); compressed 28.3 → 26.4 MB.

Gate proofs (all against the committed floors):
- cut mac zip vs pre-PR baseline: PASS (TOTAL −45.3%, no line grew) — the cut ships green even before the reseed lands
- pre-cut v1.0.504 mac zip vs new floor: **FAIL** — 4 NEW >5% lines (`wasm_run_flutter.framework` 27.1 MB, `python.wasm` 30.4 MB, `coreutils.wasm` 8.4 MB, `coach_anny.glb` 5.6 MB), TOTAL +83.2%
- pre-cut extension vs new floor: **FAIL** — glb NEW >5%, TOTAL +7.8%
- tampered cut zip (main binary +10%): **FAIL** (GREW)
- `size_manifest.py selftest`: 11/11 PASS
- per-line shapes of both cut zips otherwise byte-identical to the shipped releases (only the cut lines + engine-bump drift between v1.0.493 baselines and v1.0.504)

### Not needed (verified, deliberately no diff)
- No `wasm_setup_io.dart` change: with the framework gone, `setUp(override:false)` → `isReachable()` → `executable()` succeeds (static link + exported symbols, CI-gated) → early return. The download path never runs on release or dev builds (force_load applies to both).
- iOS podspec untouched — iOS vendors its own framework slice and statically links it.

## Remaining (owner decisions / later slices, unchanged from the issue)
- AC5: iOS lite flavor vs accept-35 MB (LiteRT/Gemma on-device stack, 35 MB iOS / 45 MB macOS)
- OQ3: `--wasm` (skwasm) spike; App.framework 89–92 MB code-size audit (direction 6)
- mac canvaskit rev-dir inner mirror (web-only shape; needs network trace before cutting — extension/web floors already carry it)
- Known gate floor: NEW-line share is 5% of TOTAL — a future single line under that (e.g. a small asset) regrows silently; the TOTAL line still covers aggregate drift.

## CI note
Per fleet policy this PR does not dispatch or rerun workflows; SM schedules CI.

+// that ONLY the removed vendored dynamic framework used to satisfy at the
+// pod-target link step:

+//   Pods.xcodeproj: wasm_run_flutter: Undefined symbols for architecture
+//   arm64: "_drop_dart_object", … referenced from:
+//   _dummy_method_to_enforce_bundling in EnforceBundling.o

+// On macOS the app does NOT need the EnforceBundling dummy: the Runner
+// target force_loads WasmRun.xcframework's libwasm_run_dart.a and exports
+// every C-ABI symbol (flutter_app/macos/Podfile), and package:wasm_run
+// resolves them at runtime via DynamicLibrary.executable(). EnforceBundling
+// is the iOS mechanism (the app there statically links the pod's vendored
+// framework and the dummy keeps dead-code stripping from discarding the
+// wire_* roots); it must not ride in the macOS pod once the framework is
+// gone. Static lint over the vendored pod, same style as

+              'the static archive feeds the Podfile force_load.',

+              'statically linking the rust archive into the pod framework '
+              'would recreate the bloat AC4 removed (dead-code stripping '
+              'cannot discard it — EnforceBundling references the symbols).',

WIRE_COUNT=$(echo "$EXPORTS" | grep -c " _wire_" || true)
          echo "wasm_run wire_* exports in binary: $WIRE_COUNT"
          for SYM in _wire_compile_wasm _store_dart_post_cobject _init_frb_dart_api_dl; do
            if ! echo "$EXPORTS" | grep -qE " ${SYM}\$"; then
              echo "::error::$SYM is not exported from the app binary — wasm_run would crash at runtime (white screen)"
              exit 1
            fi
          done
          echo "✅ wasm_run FFI symbols are exported"

      - name: Package as DMG
        id: package
        env:
          SIGNED: ${{ steps.signing.outputs.signed }}
          PROFILE_EMBEDDED: ${{ steps.signing.outputs.profile_embedded }}
          MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID: ${{ secrets.MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID }}
          VERSION: ${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          ARCH="${{ matrix.arch }}"
          APP_PATH="flutter_app/build/macos/Build/Products/Release/Fa.app"
          DMG_NAME="fa-macos-${ARCH}-${VERSION}.dmg"

          # Size diet (#1096 AC4 + direction 3): drop what no macOS code path
          # can load — before any codesign so the seal covers the shipped
          # tree. Both cuts ride in flutter_assets inside App.framework:
          # 1) assets/wasm (~47 MB) — WASI interpreter modules loaded
          #    exclusively via WasiSandboxShell (env_factory_io.dart routes
          #    desktops to the host Process shell; every rootBundle.load of
          #    assets/wasm lives in the mobile-only shell).
          # 2) packages/js_widget_runtime/test — the pub package's
          #    own test fixture (coach_anny.glb, 5.6 MB); nothing in the app
          #    references that path (the live model, when used, is fetched
          #    by the JS-app catalog, not bundled).
          ASSETS="$APP_PATH/Contents/Frameworks/App.framework/Versions/A/Resources/flutter_assets"
          # Re-enable path (review, #1096): if a desktop WASI/sandbox mode
          # ever ships (WasiSandboxShell on macOS), revert this rm and
          # reseed assets/wasm — until then a desktop wasm load would fail
          # as a missing asset, not a #1224-class "no lazy loader" stub.
          rm -rf "$ASSETS/assets/wasm" "$ASSETS/packages/js_widget_runtime/test"

          rm -f fa-macos-*.dmg tmp-fa.dmg
          rm -rf dmg-staging

          echo "Packaging: $APP_PATH → $DMG_NAME (arch: $ARCH)"

          if [ "$SIGNED" = "true" ] && [ -n "$MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID" ]; then
            echo "Signing .app bundle..."

            RESVG_BIN="$APP_PATH/Contents/Resources/resvg"
            if [ -f "$RESVG_BIN" ]; then
              echo "Stripping extended attributes from resvg..."
              xattr -cr "$RESVG_BIN" 2>/dev/null || true
              echo "Signing resvg binary..."
              codesign --force --sign "$MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID" \
                --options runtime \
                --timestamp \
                "$RESVG_BIN"
            fi

            find "$APP_PATH" -type f \( -perm +111 -o -name '*.dylib' \) | while read -r bin; do
              if codesign -dv "$bin" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "$MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID"; then
                continue
              fi
              echo "Signing nested binary: $bin"
              codesign --force --sign "$MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID" \
                --options runtime \
                --timestamp \
                "$bin" 2>/dev/null || true
            done

            if [ "$PROFILE_EMBEDDED" = "true" ] && [ -f "profile.provisionprofile" ]; then
              echo "Embedding provisioning profile..."
              cp profile.provisionprofile "$APP_PATH/Contents/embedded.provisionprofile"
              APP_ID=$(security cms -D -i profile.provisionprofile | plutil -extract Entitlements xml1 -o - - | grep -A 1 'com.apple.application-identifier' | tail -1 | sed 's/.*<string>\(.*\)<\/string>.*/\1/')
              TEAM_ID="${APP_ID%%.*}"
              # Start from Release.entitlements (network client+server, file
              # bookmarks, calendar, contacts, health, homekit, audio input)
              # and inject the provisioning identity keys — do NOT collapse
              # to a sandbox-only dict: the app needs every entitlement the
              # sandbox declares, and dropping them breaks SSO callback
              # servers, file access, and OS-level permission flows in the
              # signed production build.
              cp flutter_app/macos/Runner/Release.entitlements entitlements.plist
              # PlistBuddy handles dotted top-level key names (plutil

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1227
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1227
- **Title**: feat(1096): mac size diet — wasm_run_flutter.framework + never-loaded assets, ratcheted
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `feat/1096-size-diet` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 9
- **Additions**: +191
- **Deletions**: -36
- **Created**: 2026-10-04T13:54:04Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-04T16:47:24Z

## PR Description

Part of #1096 — slice 2: the cuts slice 1 explicitly deferred (AC4 + direction-3 analog on macOS, owner-decision items untouched). Budget-gate script unchanged; baselines reseeded onto the measured post-cut shape.

## Delivered

### AC4 — macOS app ships without `wasm_run_flutter.framework` (27.1 MB unpacked)
`vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/wasm_run_flutter.podspec`: `s.vendored_frameworks` removed. The embedded dynamic framework was a **never-loaded fallback**: the Dart FFI surface resolves via dlsym on the app's own executable — `Runner.xcodeproj` force_loads `WasmRun.xcframework/macos-arm64_x86_64/libwasm_run_dart.a` and exports the `_wire_*` symbols (verified per build by the existing `wasm_run FFI symbol verification` step). `createLibraryImpl` (`vendor/wasm_run/lib/src/ffi/io.dart:50-56`) tries `DynamicLibrary.executable()` first on macOS and `_validateLibrary` checks exactly `wire_compile_wasm` — the symbol the CI gate asserts. So `WasmRunLibrary.setUp(override: false)` no-ops on the pruned build; **no Dart change, no boot-time dylib download**. The XCFramework cache/restore/download stays untouched — the static archive feeds the force_load and the Podfile symbol check (`Podfile:132-141`); `wasmrun_restore_budget_test` stays green (5/5).

### macOS flutter_assets diet (direction 3 analog, ~52 MB unpacked)
`build-macos.yml` Package step prunes, **before any codesign**:
- `flutter_assets/assets/wasm` — ~47 MB of WASI interpreter modules loaded exclusively through `WasiSandboxShell` (`env_factory_io.dart` routes desktops to the host `Process` shell; every `rootBundle.load('assets/wasm/…')` lives in the mobile-only shell — re-verified on current main). Mobile (iOS/Android) builds untouched — they keep the full set (backward-compat invariant).
- `flutter_assets/packages/js_widget_runtime/test` — 5.6 MB coach_anny.glb test fixture of the pub package, declared as package assets; nothing in the app references that path (grep over flutter_app/lib, packages, lib, bundled JS apps).

### Same fixture prune on every other shipped web shape (5.6 MB each)
`scripts/build_browser_ext.sh` (extension zip), `.github/workflows/pages.yml` (fa1.dev), `scripts/build_office_addin.sh` (outlook pane).

### AC1 ratchet — baselines reseeded onto the post-cut shape
Both `scripts/size_budget` floors rewritten from the **real v1.0.504 release artifacts** with the cuts applied (`--reseed`; script unchanged):
- mac zip: TOTAL 203,341,721 → 111,001,004 B unpacked (**−45.3%**); compressed auto-update zip 75.8 MB → 41.0 MB (**−46%**). DMG shrinks identically.
- extension: TOTAL 78,149,373 → 72,527,489 B (**−7.1%**); compressed 28.3 → 26.4 MB.

Gate proofs (all against the committed floors):
- cut mac zip vs pre-PR baseline: PASS (TOTAL −45.3%, no line grew) — the cut ships green even before the reseed lands
- pre-cut v1.0.504 mac zip vs new floor: **FAIL** — 4 NEW >5% lines (`wasm_run_flutter.framework` 27.1 MB, `python.wasm` 30.4 MB, `coreutils.wasm` 8.4 MB, `coach_anny.glb` 5.6 MB), TOTAL +83.2%
- pre-cut extension vs new floor: **FAIL** — glb NEW >5%, TOTAL +7.8%
- tampered cut zip (main binary +10%): **FAIL** (GREW)
- `size_manifest.py selftest`: 11/11 PASS
- per-line shapes of both cut zips otherwise byte-identical to the shipped releases (only the cut lines + engine-bump drift between v1.0.493 baselines and v1.0.504)

### Not needed (verified, deliberately no diff)
- No `wasm_setup_io.dart` change: with the framework gone, `setUp(override:false)` → `isReachable()` → `executable()` succeeds (static link + exported symbols, CI-gated) → early return. The download path never runs on release or dev builds (force_load applies to both).
- iOS podspec untouched — iOS vendors its own framework slice and statically links it.

## Remaining (owner decisions / later slices, unchanged from the issue)
- AC5: iOS lite flavor vs accept-35 MB (LiteRT/Gemma on-device stack, 35 MB iOS / 45 MB macOS)
- OQ3: `--wasm` (skwasm) spike; App.framework 89–92 MB code-size audit (direction 6)
- mac canvaskit rev-dir inner mirror (web-only shape; needs network trace before cutting — extension/web floors already carry it)
- Known gate floor: NEW-line share is 5% of TOTAL — a future single line under that (e.g. a small asset) regrows silently; the TOTAL line still covers aggregate drift.

## CI note
Per fleet policy this PR does not dispatch or rerun workflows; SM schedules CI.

### AC4 — macOS app ships without `wasm_run_flutter.framework` (27.1 MB unpacked)
`vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/wasm_run_flutter.podspec`: `s.vendored_frameworks` removed. The embedded dynamic framework was a **never-loaded fallback**: the Dart FFI surface resolves via dlsym on the app's own executable — `Runner.xcodeproj` force_loads `WasmRun.xcframework/macos-arm64_x86_64/libwasm_run_dart.a` and exports the `_wire_*` symbols (verified per build by the existing `wasm_run FFI symbol verification` step). `createLibraryImpl` (`vendor/wasm_run/lib/src/ffi/io.dart:50-56`) tries `DynamicLibrary.executable()` first on macOS and `_validateLibrary` checks exactly `wire_compile_wasm` — the symbol the CI gate asserts. So `WasmRunLibrary.setUp(override: false)` no-ops on the pruned build; **no Dart change, no boot-time dylib download**. The XCFramework cache/restore/download stays untouched — the static archive feeds the force_load and the Podfile symbol check (`Podfile:132-141`); `wasmrun_restore_budget_test` stays green (5/5).

### macOS flutter_assets diet (direction 3 analog, ~52 MB unpacked)
`build-macos.yml` Package step prunes, **before any codesign**:
- `flutter_assets/assets/wasm` — ~47 MB of WASI interpreter modules loaded exclusively through `WasiSandboxShell` (`env_factory_io.dart` routes desktops to the host `Process` shell; every `rootBundle.load('assets/wasm/…')` lives in the mobile-only shell — re-verified on current main). Mobile (iOS/Android) builds untouched — they keep the full set (backward-compat invariant).
- `flutter_assets/packages/js_widget_runtime/test` — 5.6 MB coach_anny.glb test fixture of the pub package, declared as package assets; nothing in the app references that path (grep over flutter_app/lib, packages, lib, bundled JS apps).

### Same fixture prune on every other shipped web shape (5.6 MB each)
`scripts/build_browser_ext.sh` (extension zip), `.github/workflows/pages.yml` (fa1.dev), `scripts/build_office_addin.sh` (outlook pane).

- mac zip: TOTAL 203,341,721 → 111,001,004 B unpacked (**−45.3%**); compressed auto-update zip 75.8 MB → 41.0 MB (**−46%**). DMG shrinks identically.
- extension: TOTAL 78,149,373 → 72,527,489 B (**−7.1%**); compressed 28.3 → 26.4 MB.

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:

  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`

# Pull Request Information

- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `feat/1096-size-diet` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 9
- **Additions**: +191
- **Deletions**: -36
- **Created**: 2026-10-04T13:54:04Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-04T16:47:24Z

## PR Description

Part of #1096 — slice 2: the cuts slice 1 explicitly deferred (AC4 + direction-3 analog on macOS, owner-decision items untouched). Budget-gate script unchanged; baselines reseeded onto the measured post-cut shape.

## Delivered

### AC4 — macOS app ships without `wasm_run_flutter.framework` (27.1 MB unpacked)
`vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/wasm_run_flutter.podspec`: `s.vendored_frameworks` removed. The embedded dynamic framework was a **never-loaded fallback**: the Dart FFI surface resolves via dlsym on the app's own executable — `Runner.xcodeproj` force_loads `WasmRun.xcframework/macos-arm64_x86_64/libwasm_run_dart.a` and exports the `_wire_*` symbols (verified per build by the existing `wasm_run FFI symbol verification` step). `createLibraryImpl` (`vendor/wasm_run/lib/src/ffi/io.dart:50-56`) tries `DynamicLibrary.executable()` first on macOS and `_validateLibrary` checks exactly `wire_compile_wasm` — the symbol the CI gate asserts. So `WasmRunLibrary.setUp(override: false)` no-ops on the pruned build; **no Dart change, no boot-time dylib download**. The XCFramework cache/restore/download stays untouched — the static archive feeds the force_load and the Podfile symbol check (`Podfile:132-141`); `wasmrun_restore_budget_test` stays green (5/5).

### macOS flutter_assets diet (direction 3 analog, ~52 MB unpacked)
`build-macos.yml` Package step prunes, **before any codesign**:
- `flutter_assets/assets/wasm` — ~47 MB of WASI interpreter modules loaded exclusively through `WasiSandboxShell` (`env_factory_io.dart` routes desktops to the host `Process` shell; every `rootBundle.load('assets/wasm/…')` lives in the mobile-only shell — re-verified on current main). Mobile (iOS/Android) builds untouched — they keep the full set (backward-compat invariant).
- `flutter_assets/packages/js_widget_runtime/test` — 5.6 MB coach_anny.glb test fixture of the pub package, declared as package assets; nothing in the app references that path (grep over flutter_app/lib, packages, lib, bundled JS apps).

### Same fixture prune on every other shipped web shape (5.6 MB each)
`scripts/build_browser_ext.sh` (extension zip), `.github/workflows/pages.yml` (fa1.dev), `scripts/build_office_addin.sh` (outlook pane).

### AC1 ratchet — baselines reseeded onto the post-cut shape
Both `scripts/size_budget` floors rewritten from the **real v1.0.504 release artifacts** with the cuts applied (`--reseed`; script unchanged):
- mac zip: TOTAL 203,341,721 → 111,001,004 B unpacked (**−45.3%**); compressed auto-update zip 75.8 MB → 41.0 MB (**−46%**). DMG shrinks identically.
- extension: TOTAL 78,149,373 → 72,527,489 B (**−7.1%**); compressed 28.3 → 26.4 MB.

Gate proofs (all against the committed floors):
- cut mac zip vs pre-PR baseline: PASS (TOTAL −45.3%, no line grew) — the cut ships green even before the reseed lands
- pre-cut v1.0.504 mac zip vs new floor: **FAIL** — 4 NEW >5% lines (`wasm_run_flutter.framework` 27.1 MB, `python.wasm` 30.4 MB, `coreutils.wasm` 8.4 MB, `coach_anny.glb` 5.6 MB), TOTAL +83.2%
- pre-cut extension vs new floor: **FAIL** — glb NEW >5%, TOTAL +7.8%
- tampered cut zip (main binary +10%): **FAIL** (GREW)
- `size_manifest.py selftest`: 11/11 PASS
- per-line shapes of both cut zips otherwise byte-identical to the shipped releases (only the cut lines + engine-bump drift between v1.0.493 baselines and v1.0.504)

### Not needed (verified, deliberately no diff)
- No `wasm_setup_io.dart` change: with the framework gone, `setUp(override:false)` → `isReachable()` → `executable()` succeeds (static link + exported symbols, CI-gated) → early return. The download path never runs on release or dev builds (force_load applies to both).
- iOS podspec untouched — iOS vendors its own framework slice and statically links it.

## Remaining (owner decisions / later slices, unchanged from the issue)
- AC5: iOS lite flavor vs accept-35 MB (LiteRT/Gemma on-device stack, 35 MB iOS / 45 MB macOS)
- OQ3: `--wasm` (skwasm) spike; App.framework 89–92 MB code-size audit (direction 6)
- mac canvaskit rev-dir inner mirror (web-only shape; needs network trace before cutting — extension/web floors already carry it)
- Known gate floor: NEW-line share is 5% of TOTAL — a future single line under that (e.g. a small asset) regrows silently; the TOTAL line still covers aggregate drift.

## CI note
Per fleet policy this PR does not dispatch or rerun workflows; SM schedules CI.

+// references ~200 flutter_rust_bridge symbols (_wire_*, _new_*, _drop_*, …)
+// that ONLY the removed vendored dynamic framework used to satisfy at the
+// pod-target link step:

+//   arm64: "_drop_dart_object", … referenced from:
+//   _dummy_method_to_enforce_bundling in EnforceBundling.o

+// target force_loads WasmRun.xcframework's libwasm_run_dart.a and exports
+// every C-ABI symbol (flutter_app/macos/Podfile), and package:wasm_run
+// resolves them at runtime via DynamicLibrary.executable(). EnforceBundling
+// is the iOS mechanism (the app there statically links the pod's vendored
+// framework and the dummy keeps dead-code stripping from discarding the
+// wire_* roots); it must not ride in the macOS pod once the framework is

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1227
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1227
- **Title**: feat(1096): mac size diet — wasm_run_flutter.framework + never-loaded assets, ratcheted
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `feat/1096-size-diet` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 9
- **Additions**: +191
- **Deletions**: -36
- **Created**: 2026-10-04T13:54:04Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-04T16:47:24Z

## PR Description

Part of #1096 — slice 2: the cuts slice 1 explicitly deferred (AC4 + direction-3 analog on macOS, owner-decision items untouched). Budget-gate script unchanged; baselines reseeded onto the measured post-cut shape.

## Delivered

### AC4 — macOS app ships without `wasm_run_flutter.framework` (27.1 MB unpacked)
`vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/wasm_run_flutter.podspec`: `s.vendored_frameworks` removed. The embedded dynamic framework was a **never-loaded fallback**: the Dart FFI surface resolves via dlsym on the app's own executable — `Runner.xcodeproj` force_loads `WasmRun.xcframework/macos-arm64_x86_64/libwasm_run_dart.a` and exports the `_wire_*` symbols (verified per build by the existing `wasm_run FFI symbol verification` step). `createLibraryImpl` (`vendor/wasm_run/lib/src/ffi/io.dart:50-56`) tries `DynamicLibrary.executable()` first on macOS and `_validateLibrary` checks exactly `wire_compile_wasm` — the symbol the CI gate asserts. So `WasmRunLibrary.setUp(override: false)` no-ops on the pruned build; **no Dart change, no boot-time dylib download**. The XCFramework cache/restore/download stays untouched — the static archive feeds the force_load and the Podfile symbol check (`Podfile:132-141`); `wasmrun_restore_budget_test` stays green (5/5).

### macOS flutter_assets diet (direction 3 analog, ~52 MB unpacked)
`build-macos.yml` Package step prunes, **before any codesign**:
- `flutter_assets/assets/wasm` — ~47 MB of WASI interpreter modules loaded exclusively through `WasiSandboxShell` (`env_factory_io.dart` routes desktops to the host `Process` shell; every `rootBundle.load('assets/wasm/…')` lives in the mobile-only shell — re-verified on current main). Mobile (iOS/Android) builds untouched — they keep the full set (backward-compat invariant).
- `flutter_assets/packages/js_widget_runtime/test` — 5.6 MB coach_anny.glb test fixture of the pub package, declared as package assets; nothing in the app references that path (grep over flutter_app/lib, packages, lib, bundled JS apps).

### Same fixture prune on every other shipped web shape (5.6 MB each)
`scripts/build_browser_ext.sh` (extension zip), `.github/workflows/pages.yml` (fa1.dev), `scripts/build_office_addin.sh` (outlook pane).

### AC1 ratchet — baselines reseeded onto the post-cut shape
Both `scripts/size_budget` floors rewritten from the **real v1.0.504 release artifacts** with the cuts applied (`--reseed`; script unchanged):
- mac zip: TOTAL 203,341,721 → 111,001,004 B unpacked (**−45.3%**); compressed auto-update zip 75.8 MB → 41.0 MB (**−46%**). DMG shrinks identically.
- extension: TOTAL 78,149,373 → 72,527,489 B (**−7.1%**); compressed 28.3 → 26.4 MB.

Gate proofs (all against the committed floors):
- cut mac zip vs pre-PR baseline: PASS (TOTAL −45.3%, no line grew) — the cut ships green even before the reseed lands
- pre-cut v1.0.504 mac zip vs new floor: **FAIL** — 4 NEW >5% lines (`wasm_run_flutter.framework` 27.1 MB, `python.wasm` 30.4 MB, `coreutils.wasm` 8.4 MB, `coach_anny.glb` 5.6 MB), TOTAL +83.2%
- pre-cut extension vs new floor: **FAIL** — glb NEW >5%, TOTAL +7.8%
- tampered cut zip (main binary +10%): **FAIL** (GREW)
- `size_manifest.py selftest`: 11/11 PASS
- per-line shapes of both cut zips otherwise byte-identical to the shipped releases (only the cut lines + engine-bump drift between v1.0.493 baselines and v1.0.504)

### Not needed (verified, deliberately no diff)
- No `wasm_setup_io.dart` change: with the framework gone, `setUp(override:false)` → `isReachable()` → `executable()` succeeds (static link + exported symbols, CI-gated) → early return. The download path never runs on release or dev builds (force_load applies to both).
- iOS podspec untouched — iOS vendors its own framework slice and statically links it.

## Remaining (owner decisions / later slices, unchanged from the issue)
- AC5: iOS lite flavor vs accept-35 MB (LiteRT/Gemma on-device stack, 35 MB iOS / 45 MB macOS)
- OQ3: `--wasm` (skwasm) spike; App.framework 89–92 MB code-size audit (direction 6)
- mac canvaskit rev-dir inner mirror (web-only shape; needs network trace before cutting — extension/web floors already carry it)
- Known gate floor: NEW-line share is 5% of TOTAL — a future single line under that (e.g. a small asset) regrows silently; the TOTAL line still covers aggregate drift.

## CI note
Per fleet policy this PR does not dispatch or rerun workflows; SM schedules CI.

# Rework: fix red `Build macOS (debug)` leg (Quality gate)

## Issues/Notes

- **CI failure (root cause)**: head `cc81c735` went red on `build-macos` (Quality gate leg `Build macOS (debug)`). The link step of the `wasm_run_flutter` pod target failed with **~200 undefined symbols for architecture arm64** (`_drop_dart_object`, `_inflate_*`, `_new_*`, `_wire_*`, …) referenced from `_dummy_method_to_enforce_bundling in EnforceBundling.o`.
- **Why**: the PR removed `s.vendored_frameworks` from `vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/wasm_run_flutter.podspec` (AC4 — drop the 27 MB never-loaded `wasm_run_flutter.framework`). But `Classes/EnforceBundling.swift` still rode in the macOS pod. Its dummy references the flutter_rust_bridge symbols that **only the removed vendored dynamic framework used to satisfy** at the pod-target link step — so the pod target now links against nothing defining them and the build fails before the app ever links.
- **Why no other fix**: re-vendoring anything (`vendored_frameworks` or `vendored_libraries` on the static archive) would either resurrect the 27 MB framework or statically link the rust archive into the pod framework — recreating the bloat AC4 removed. The pod target also never needed the dummy: the **Runner** target force_loads `libwasm_run_dart.a` and exports every FFI symbol (`flutter_app/macos/Podfile`, non-Debug; Debug exports all globals), and `package:wasm_run` resolves them via `DynamicLibrary.executable()`. `EnforceBundling` is the **iOS** mechanism (app statically links the pod's vendored framework there; the dummy keeps dead-code stripping from discarding the `wire_*` roots) — iOS podspec is untouched.
- **Review threads**: thread 1 (re-enable pointer note) was already resolved before this rework (pointer landed at the rm site in `build-macos.yml`). The only open item is the CI-red notice — fixed by this change.

## Approach

TDD (RED → GREEN → full suite), same static-lint style as the existing `wasmrun_restore_budget_test.dart` (the failure is link-time on macOS; this Linux runner cannot run `flutter build macos`, so the guard lints the exact invariant the linker enforces):

1. **RED** — added `test/wasmrun_macos_pod_link_test.dart`: fails if the macOS podspec vendors any framework/library, if `macos/Classes/` compiles any source (`.swift`/`.m`/`.c`/…) while doing so, or if the Podfile stops force_loading/exporting the static archive (the provider side). It reproduced the failure: `EnforceBundling.swift` flagged as the offending compiled source.
2. **GREEN** — removed `vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/Classes/EnforceBundling.swift` (header-only pod; `frb.h` stays as the public FFI surface so `pod install` materializes the target) and rewrote the podspec comment to document *why*: the header-only macOS pod, where the symbols actually come from (Runner force_load + exported symbols), the iOS-vs-macOS EnforceBundling distinction, and the exact link error this prevents.
3. Verified the podspec still parses (`ruby -c` → Syntax OK) and no remaining reference to `EnforceBundling` exists in the macOS plugin/app.

## Files Modified

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/Classes/EnforceBundling.swift` | **Deleted** — iOS-only mechanism; its undefined FFI references broke the pod-target link once the vendored framework was removed |
| `vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/wasm_run_flutter.podspec` | Comment rewritten: documents the header-only macOS pod, the Runner force_load/export symbol source, and the link failure this guards against |
| `test/wasmrun_macos_pod_link_test.dart` | **New** — static lint pinning the linkability invariant (no vendored framework/library; no compiled sources in the macOS pod; Podfile keeps force_load + exported_symbol) |

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1227
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1227
- **Title**: feat(1096): mac size diet — wasm_run_flutter.framework + never-loaded assets, ratcheted
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `feat/1096-size-diet` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 9
- **Additions**: +191
- **Deletions**: -36
- **Created**: 2026-10-04T13:54:04Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-04T16:47:24Z

## PR Description

Part of #1096 — slice 2: the cuts slice 1 explicitly deferred (AC4 + direction-3 analog on macOS, owner-decision items untouched). Budget-gate script unchanged; baselines reseeded onto the measured post-cut shape.

## Delivered

### AC4 — macOS app ships without `wasm_run_flutter.framework` (27.1 MB unpacked)
`vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/wasm_run_flutter.podspec`: `s.vendored_frameworks` removed. The embedded dynamic framework was a **never-loaded fallback**: the Dart FFI surface resolves via dlsym on the app's own executable — `Runner.xcodeproj` force_loads `WasmRun.xcframework/macos-arm64_x86_64/libwasm_run_dart.a` and exports the `_wire_*` symbols (verified per build by the existing `wasm_run FFI symbol verification` step). `createLibraryImpl` (`vendor/wasm_run/lib/src/ffi/io.dart:50-56`) tries `DynamicLibrary.executable()` first on macOS and `_validateLibrary` checks exactly `wire_compile_wasm` — the symbol the CI gate asserts. So `WasmRunLibrary.setUp(override: false)` no-ops on the pruned build; **no Dart change, no boot-time dylib download**. The XCFramework cache/restore/download stays untouched — the static archive feeds the force_load and the Podfile symbol check (`Podfile:132-141`); `wasmrun_restore_budget_test` stays green (5/5).

### macOS flutter_assets diet (direction 3 analog, ~52 MB unpacked)
`build-macos.yml` Package step prunes, **before any codesign**:
- `flutter_assets/assets/wasm` — ~47 MB of WASI interpreter modules loaded exclusively through `WasiSandboxShell` (`env_factory_io.dart` routes desktops to the host `Process` shell; every `rootBundle.load('assets/wasm/…')` lives in the mobile-only shell — re-verified on current main). Mobile (iOS/Android) builds untouched — they keep the full set (backward-compat invariant).
- `flutter_assets/packages/js_widget_runtime/test` — 5.6 MB coach_anny.glb test fixture of the pub package, declared as package assets; nothing in the app references that path (grep over flutter_app/lib, packages, lib, bundled JS apps).

### Same fixture prune on every other shipped web shape (5.6 MB each)
`scripts/build_browser_ext.sh` (extension zip), `.github/workflows/pages.yml` (fa1.dev), `scripts/build_office_addin.sh` (outlook pane).

### AC1 ratchet — baselines reseeded onto the post-cut shape
Both `scripts/size_budget` floors rewritten from the **real v1.0.504 release artifacts** with the cuts applied (`--reseed`; script unchanged):
- mac zip: TOTAL 203,341,721 → 111,001,004 B unpacked (**−45.3%**); compressed auto-update zip 75.8 MB → 41.0 MB (**−46%**). DMG shrinks identically.
- extension: TOTAL 78,149,373 → 72,527,489 B (**−7.1%**); compressed 28.3 → 26.4 MB.

Gate proofs (all against the committed floors):
- cut mac zip vs pre-PR baseline: PASS (TOTAL −45.3%, no line grew) — the cut ships green even before the reseed lands
- pre-cut v1.0.504 mac zip vs new floor: **FAIL** — 4 NEW >5% lines (`wasm_run_flutter.framework` 27.1 MB, `python.wasm` 30.4 MB, `coreutils.wasm` 8.4 MB, `coach_anny.glb` 5.6 MB), TOTAL +83.2%
- pre-cut extension vs new floor: **FAIL** — glb NEW >5%, TOTAL +7.8%
- tampered cut zip (main binary +10%): **FAIL** (GREW)
- `size_manifest.py selftest`: 11/11 PASS
- per-line shapes of both cut zips otherwise byte-identical to the shipped releases (only the cut lines + engine-bump drift between v1.0.493 baselines and v1.0.504)

### Not needed (verified, deliberately no diff)
- No `wasm_setup_io.dart` change: with the framework gone, `setUp(override:false)` → `isReachable()` → `executable()` succeeds (static link + exported symbols, CI-gated) → early return. The download path never runs on release or dev builds (force_load applies to both).
- iOS podspec untouched — iOS vendors its own framework slice and statically links it.

## Remaining (owner decisions / later slices, unchanged from the issue)
- AC5: iOS lite flavor vs accept-35 MB (LiteRT/Gemma on-device stack, 35 MB iOS / 45 MB macOS)
- OQ3: `--wasm` (skwasm) spike; App.framework 89–92 MB code-size audit (direction 6)
- mac canvaskit rev-dir inner mirror (web-only shape; needs network trace before cutting — extension/web floors already carry it)
- Known gate floor: NEW-line share is 5% of TOTAL — a future single line under that (e.g. a small asset) regrows silently; the TOTAL line still covers aggregate drift.

## CI note
Per fleet policy this PR does not dispatch or rerun workflows; SM schedules CI.

- name: Build and package no-sandbox release
        id: package_nosandbox
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}
          ARCH: ${{ matrix.arch }}
          FA_CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY: ${{ secrets.MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID }}
          FA_DEVELOPMENT_TEAM: ${{ secrets.MACOS_NOTARIZE_TEAM_ID }}
          PROFILE_UUID: ${{ steps.signing.outputs.profile_uuid }}
          PROFILE_TEAM: ${{ steps.signing.outputs.profile_team }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cd flutter_app
          if [ -z "${FA_DEVELOPMENT_TEAM:-}" ] && [ -n "${PROFILE_TEAM:-}" ]; then
            export FA_DEVELOPMENT_TEAM="$PROFILE_TEAM"
          fi
          if [ -n "${PROFILE_UUID:-}" ]; then
            export FA_PROVISIONING_PROFILE_SPECIFIER="$PROFILE_UUID"
          fi
          FLUTTER_XCODE_ARCHS="$ARCH" ./scripts/build_macos_nosandbox.sh
          APP_PATH="build/macos/Build/Products/Release/Fa.app"

          NO_DMGTMP="tmp-fa-nosandbox.dmg"
          rm -rf dmg-staging-nosandbox
          mkdir dmg-staging-nosandbox
          cp -R "$APP_PATH" dmg-staging-nosandbox/

- **Branch**: `feat/1096-size-diet` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 9
- **Additions**: +191
- **Deletions**: -36
- **Created**: 2026-10-04T13:54:04Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-04T16:47:24Z

## PR Description

Part of #1096 — slice 2: the cuts slice 1 explicitly deferred (AC4 + direction-3 analog on macOS, owner-decision items untouched). Budget-gate script unchanged; baselines reseeded onto the measured post-cut shape.

## Delivered

### AC4 — macOS app ships without `wasm_run_flutter.framework` (27.1 MB unpacked)
`vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/wasm_run_flutter.podspec`: `s.vendored_frameworks` removed. The embedded dynamic framework was a **never-loaded fallback**: the Dart FFI surface resolves via dlsym on the app's own executable — `Runner.xcodeproj` force_loads `WasmRun.xcframework/macos-arm64_x86_64/libwasm_run_dart.a` and exports the `_wire_*` symbols (verified per build by the existing `wasm_run FFI symbol verification` step). `createLibraryImpl` (`vendor/wasm_run/lib/src/ffi/io.dart:50-56`) tries `DynamicLibrary.executable()` first on macOS and `_validateLibrary` checks exactly `wire_compile_wasm` — the symbol the CI gate asserts. So `WasmRunLibrary.setUp(override: false)` no-ops on the pruned build; **no Dart change, no boot-time dylib download**. The XCFramework cache/restore/download stays untouched — the static archive feeds the force_load and the Podfile symbol check (`Podfile:132-141`); `wasmrun_restore_budget_test` stays green (5/5).

### macOS flutter_assets diet (direction 3 analog, ~52 MB unpacked)
`build-macos.yml` Package step prunes, **before any codesign**:
- `flutter_assets/assets/wasm` — ~47 MB of WASI interpreter modules loaded exclusively through `WasiSandboxShell` (`env_factory_io.dart` routes desktops to the host `Process` shell; every `rootBundle.load('assets/wasm/…')` lives in the mobile-only shell — re-verified on current main). Mobile (iOS/Android) builds untouched — they keep the full set (backward-compat invariant).
- `flutter_assets/packages/js_widget_runtime/test` — 5.6 MB coach_anny.glb test fixture of the pub package, declared as package assets; nothing in the app references that path (grep over flutter_app/lib, packages, lib, bundled JS apps).

### Same fixture prune on every other shipped web shape (5.6 MB each)
`scripts/build_browser_ext.sh` (extension zip), `.github/workflows/pages.yml` (fa1.dev), `scripts/build_office_addin.sh` (outlook pane).

### AC1 ratchet — baselines reseeded onto the post-cut shape
Both `scripts/size_budget` floors rewritten from the **real v1.0.504 release artifacts** with the cuts applied (`--reseed`; script unchanged):
- mac zip: TOTAL 203,341,721 → 111,001,004 B unpacked (**−45.3%**); compressed auto-update zip 75.8 MB → 41.0 MB (**−46%**). DMG shrinks identically.
- extension: TOTAL 78,149,373 → 72,527,489 B (**−7.1%**); compressed 28.3 → 26.4 MB.

Gate proofs (all against the committed floors):
- cut mac zip vs pre-PR baseline: PASS (TOTAL −45.3%, no line grew) — the cut ships green even before the reseed lands
- pre-cut v1.0.504 mac zip vs new floor: **FAIL** — 4 NEW >5% lines (`wasm_run_flutter.framework` 27.1 MB, `python.wasm` 30.4 MB, `coreutils.wasm` 8.4 MB, `coach_anny.glb` 5.6 MB), TOTAL +83.2%
- pre-cut extension vs new floor: **FAIL** — glb NEW >5%, TOTAL +7.8%
- tampered cut zip (main binary +10%): **FAIL** (GREW)
- `size_manifest.py selftest`: 11/11 PASS
- per-line shapes of both cut zips otherwise byte-identical to the shipped releases (only the cut lines + engine-bump drift between v1.0.493 baselines and v1.0.504)

### Not needed (verified, deliberately no diff)
- No `wasm_setup_io.dart` change: with the framework gone, `setUp(override:false)` → `isReachable()` → `executable()` succeeds (static link + exported symbols, CI-gated) → early return. The download path never runs on release or dev builds (force_load applies to both).
- iOS podspec untouched — iOS vendors its own framework slice and statically links it.

## Remaining (owner decisions / later slices, unchanged from the issue)
- AC5: iOS lite flavor vs accept-35 MB (LiteRT/Gemma on-device stack, 35 MB iOS / 45 MB macOS)
- OQ3: `--wasm` (skwasm) spike; App.framework 89–92 MB code-size audit (direction 6)
- mac canvaskit rev-dir inner mirror (web-only shape; needs network trace before cutting — extension/web floors already carry it)
- Known gate floor: NEW-line share is 5% of TOTAL — a future single line under that (e.g. a small asset) regrows silently; the TOTAL line still covers aggregate drift.

## CI note
Per fleet policy this PR does not dispatch or rerun workflows; SM schedules CI.

+//   arm64: "_drop_dart_object", … referenced from:

+// target force_loads WasmRun.xcframework's libwasm_run_dart.a and exports
+// every C-ABI symbol (flutter_app/macos/Podfile), and package:wasm_run
+// resolves them at runtime via DynamicLibrary.executable(). EnforceBundling
+// is the iOS mechanism (the app there statically links the pod's vendored
+// framework and the dummy keeps dead-code stripping from discarding the
+// wire_* roots); it must not ride in the macOS pod once the framework is

WIRE_COUNT=$(echo "$EXPORTS" | grep -c " _wire_" || true)
          echo "wasm_run wire_* exports in binary: $WIRE_COUNT"
          for SYM in _wire_compile_wasm _store_dart_post_cobject _init_frb_dart_api_dl; do
            if ! echo "$EXPORTS" | grep -qE " ${SYM}\$"; then
              echo "::error::$SYM is not exported from the app binary — wasm_run would crash at runtime (white screen)"
              exit 1
            fi
          done
          echo "✅ wasm_run FFI symbols are exported"

      - name: Package as DMG
        id: package
        env:
          SIGNED: ${{ steps.signing.outputs.signed }}
          PROFILE_EMBEDDED: ${{ steps.signing.outputs.profile_embedded }}
          MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID: ${{ secrets.MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID }}
          VERSION: ${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          ARCH="${{ matrix.arch }}"
          APP_PATH="flutter_app/build/macos/Build/Products/Release/Fa.app"
          DMG_NAME="fa-macos-${ARCH}-${VERSION}.dmg"

          # Size diet (#1096 AC4 + direction 3): drop what no macOS code path
          # can load — before any codesign so the seal covers the shipped
          # tree. Both cuts ride in flutter_assets inside App.framework:
          # 1) assets/wasm (~47 MB) — WASI interpreter modules loaded
          #    exclusively via WasiSandboxShell (env_factory_io.dart routes
          #    desktops to the host Process shell; every rootBundle.load of
          #    assets/wasm lives in the mobile-only shell).
          # 2) packages/js_widget_runtime/test — the pub package's
          #    own test fixture (coach_anny.glb, 5.6 MB); nothing in the app
          #    references that path (the live model, when used, is fetched
          #    by the JS-app catalog, not bundled).
          ASSETS="$APP_PATH/Contents/Frameworks/App.framework/Versions/A/Resources/flutter_assets"
          # Re-enable path (review, #1096): if a desktop WASI/sandbox mode
          # ever ships (WasiSandboxShell on macOS), revert this rm and
          # reseed assets/wasm — until then a desktop wasm load would fail
          # as a missing asset, not a #1224-class "no lazy loader" stub.
          rm -rf "$ASSETS/assets/wasm" "$ASSETS/packages/js_widget_runtime/test"

          rm -f fa-macos-*.dmg tmp-fa.dmg
          rm -rf dmg-staging

          echo "Packaging: $APP_PATH → $DMG_NAME (arch: $ARCH)"

          if [ "$SIGNED" = "true" ] && [ -n "$MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID" ]; then
            echo "Signing .app bundle..."

            RESVG_BIN="$APP_PATH/Contents/Resources/resvg"
            if [ -f "$RESVG_BIN" ]; then
              echo "Stripping extended attributes from resvg..."
              xattr -cr "$RESVG_BIN" 2>/dev/null || true
              echo "Signing resvg binary..."
              codesign --force --sign "$MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID" \
                --options runtime \
                --timestamp \
                "$RESVG_BIN"
            fi

            find "$APP_PATH" -type f \( -perm +111 -o -name '*.dylib' \) | while read -r bin; do
              if codesign -dv "$bin" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "$MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID"; then
                continue
              fi
              echo "Signing nested binary: $bin"
              codesign --force --sign "$MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID" \
                --options runtime \
                --timestamp \
                "$bin" 2>/dev/null || true
            done

            if [ "$PROFILE_EMBEDDED" = "true" ] && [ -f "profile.provisionprofile" ]; then
              echo "Embedding provisioning profile..."
              cp profile.provisionprofile "$APP_PATH/Contents/embedded.provisionprofile"
              APP_ID=$(security cms -D -i profile.provisionprofile | plutil -extract Entitlements xml1 -o - - | grep -A 1 'com.apple.application-identifier' | tail -1 | sed 's/.*<string>\(.*\)<\/string>.*/\1/')
              TEAM_ID="${APP_ID%%.*}"
              # Start from Release.entitlements (network client+server, file
              # bookmarks, calendar, contacts, health, homekit, audio input)
              # and inject the provisioning identity keys — do NOT collapse
              # to a sandbox-only dict: the app needs every entitlement the
              # sandbox declares, and dropping them breaks SSO callback
              # servers, file access, and OS-level permission flows in the
              # signed production build.
              cp flutter_app/macos/Runner/Release.entitlements entitlements.plist
              # PlistBuddy handles dotted top-level key names (plutil
              # -insert/-replace treats dots as nested key separators).
